summary: The scope is now smaller: the account hint is removed. Every Google authorization URL now gets `prompt=select_account consent`, and unnamed connection cards carry `newConnection: true` so that starting them adds a connection without reconnecting the "default" placeholder. Durable tests cover the Google prompt through submitSetup and the released-client placeholder path. Temp tests cover the marker, card merging, and reconnecting a connection actually named "default". All tests pass, every changed line is covered, and no findings remain.
